evidence.detail: R115 ScriptPacketDispatcher registers rs/n/c/c/e directly as exact ScriptPacket ID 31.

The handler resolves only controllers owned by rs/n/c/c/a, independently recovered in R2 as MailboxInterface from exact Inbox/Mail Subject/delete-message/attached-item literals and misc/mail resources.

Selectors 0, 1, 2, 5 and 7 operate on the mailbox inbox-list controller: reset/finalize list state, append String rows, update indexed row state, clear row selection state and select a packet-specified row. Its exact row-state enum preserves READ and UNREAD.

Selectors 3 and 4 operate on the mailbox attached-item/reward controller. The exact claim-state enum preserves EMPTY, UNCLAIMED and CLAIMED, and the same controller writes the exact message '@gre@Items have been claimed!'.

All selectors 0 through 7 stay within the mailbox interface domain or its presentation helpers. Selector 6 emits packet-triggered particles through the generic overlay particle manager at the mailbox reward-panel screen region but does not mutate a second Client subsystem.

proposals.note: MailboxInterfacePacketHandler is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for ScriptPacket 31. Its complete selector surface controls the exact MailboxInterface inbox/read-state/attached-item claim presentation, with only a generic visual-effect helper outside the mailbox package. No surviving original class identifier is claimed. Confidence is 0.998.
